Cryptorchidism is a condition in which one or both the testicles are undescended in the scrotal sac. It is an Hereditary abnormality, meaning its passed on from one generation to the next generation.
The undescended testicle can be subcutaneous( Beneath the skin) or intra-abdominal( inside the Abdomen).
These Testicles have a very high chance of heading towards Sertoli cell tumours.
 Mating of such dogs should be discouraged and should be neutered wherein both the Testicles are removed.

I am giving one star only because the review cannot be posted without selecting a star; otherwise, this vet does not deserve even a single star.

Our beloved pet cat passed away due to prolonged treatment at this clinic where proper and timely medical care was not provided.

Worst experience overall.

My cat had a pus-filled wound on the stomach area, yet for almost an entire month no medicines or ointments were prescribed. During every dressing, the vet used only saline and did not apply even basic antiseptic solutions or any healing ointment.

We repeatedly requested medication to control the pus and infection, but nothing was given for a month. After repeated insistence, the doctor after a month finally prescribed medicines for pus prevention and a wound-healing spray, but by then the damage had already been done.

We also asked whether any skin tests were required, as the wound was not healing and my cat had experienced a similar wound in the same area about a year earlier. The doctor denied the need for any tests and stated that none were required.

Despite this, the doctor continued giving injections on every visit and instructed us to administer them twice daily for an entire month.

We clearly informed the vet that continuous bandaging was causing our cat severe discomfort and difficulty in urinating and passing stool. Our concerns were ignored, and the same bandaging was continued at every visit. Instead of improving, the wound worsened drastically and became almost four times larger.

During dressing, we witnessed the originally small wound enlarged and develop a deep internal hole, which was extremely distressing as pet owners.

We also raised concerns about breathing issues, but no tests or treatment were provided for this either.

On one visit, we waited over an hour for the doctor while he was busy discussing charges for another patient with the another doctor. We clearly observed him indicating by hand signs whether to charge ₹9,000 or ₹10,000, after which ₹10,000 was decided. This gave us a strong impression that financial matters were being prioritized over patient care.

We expected timely diagnosis, proper wound management, transparency in treatment, and genuine concern for our pet’s health. Unfortunately, none of this was provided. We are deeply disappointed and would not recommend this vet based on our experience.

If you love your pet, please do not go here. Do not trust this vet.

Its common knowledge that finding a genuine vet who actually cares and treats correctly is like finding a needle in a haystack. So when our go-to vet was unavailable and he recommended Central vets, the only question we asked was would you trust them with your pet.

So, I got my beagle Oshie to them for a suspected case of pyometra. Dr Patil did the USG and immediately confirmed the diagnosis. featured_reviews.name: Purna Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re an invested pet parent like me, this review might help you make an informed choice for your pet and yourself:

I first came across Central Vets (I'll use 'CV' from here on) through a cat rescuer friend, who told me something that really shocked me: most vets vaccinate cats in the wrong spots, which can cause a rare but dangerous condition. She said only the doctors at CV not only vaccinate in the correct spots, but also note it down (I had never seen that at any clinic in Mumbai - even the fancy ones) on the records which they hand over to you for your documentation. That alone made me want to try CV, and it’s been 3 years now.

Since then, Dr. Patil has become our doctor. As a pet parent, every single decision about your pet’s health - food, water, medicine, treatment, when, how much, how little,... - feels like it rests on you. One mistake and the responsibility is yours. That’s why finding someone you can fully trust is so important. For us, that’s Dr. Patil. We blindly trust his advice.

But it’s not just Dr. Patil - Dr. Shelar and the whole team are equally gentle, professional, and caring. At other clinics, it used to take 3–4 people to pin my 3kg cat down just to check her weight or give her a tablet. At CV, she often comes out of the carrier on her own, and even on days when she’s stressed from the travel (we live a bit far), they patiently wait and use kind techniques. That matters so much to me.

Another big thing: hygiene. I’ve seen some top-rated clinics in Mumbai that are shockingly unhygienic. At CV, it’s always spotless. Plus, their new space makes it all the more better - it is not only bigger but also super clean, airy, and comfortable for pets. There's also plenty space to sit and pace around with your pet in the waiting area.

I’ll share one example: during the rains I couldn’t travel all the way to CV, so I gave in and visited a local vet for my cat’s ear infection. Big mistake. Not only was the place unhygienic, but she also ended up catching the flu there. We wasted money, she suffered, and I felt stressed and guilty. That same evening I called CV, Dr. Patil recommended an ear drop, and within 3 days she was already so much better. Later, when we could make a visit, we went in for her proper treatment. That’s when I realized trust is everything, and we blindly trust our doctor.

Another plus if you are cat lover!: CV also cares for strays! Their old clinic had a tomcat called Damodar, and now their new space has another sweetie hanging around (with his own litter box haha). But don’t worry, the hygiene never slips. The clinic is still super clean and safe.

Lastly, a special mention to the lady at the reception who manages calls, appointments, and queries. She’s always kind and efficient, and has often helped us connect with the doctors when we couldn’t make it to the clinic or when it was after hours.

In short, CV is our safe space, and we rank it 5⭐️ on all parameters. I've recommended it to my friends, acquaintances, and fellows from the cat parent community. If you genuinely care about your pet’s health and wellbeing, I can’t recommend them enough.

My overall experience at PoshPets was satisfactory, with a few points worth highlighting for pet parents.

The store itself is well stocked — they offer a wide variety of pet foods, numerous treat options, and essentials such as pet wipes. Their toy selection is moderate but adequate. I was also informed that they provide several clinical services, including X-ray, 2D Echo, ultrasound, dental care, and have a veterinarian available on call. I did not use these services, but it is reassuring to know they are offered.

My visit this time was primarily for grooming my two Golden Retrievers. The grooming results were decent, and the overall job was acceptable. However, I did feel disappointed with the way the drying process was handled. They became anxious with the sound of the dryer, and I sensed the staff were a little rough or rushed, which made the dogs increasingly uncomfortable.

At one point, when I was trying to comfort them, a staff member asked me to wait outside — something I strongly disagreed with. As their pet parent, leaving them alone with strangers while they were visibly anxious was simply not an option for me. One of the dogs, who rarely barks, was barking continuously, which further indicated discomfort. Whether it was the air pressure of the blower or just the handling, they were not as calm as they usually are with me or at the other salon we frequent.

For comparison, I regularly visit another salon, which is smaller but far more gentle and consistent in their handling. I have never been asked to leave the room there, and my dogs have always been comfortable throughout the process.

Overall, PoshPets is a great place for pet supplies, and I would definitely return for shopping. However, for grooming, I would prefer to go elsewhere unless absolutely necessary, as I am particular about how my pets are handled — even the slightest roughness is not acceptable to me.

Coco was brought to us only once; subsequent treatment and monitoring were carried out elsewhere, outside our supervision. He was presented after reportedly not eating for 29 days, with vomiting, lethargy, severe kidney values, very high phosphorus, and severe metabolic acidosis.

We had explained the seriousness of Coco’s condition, including a guarded prognosis and suspected AoCKD / IRIS AKI Grade V. The treatment plan, monitoring instructions, recommended investigations with the referring veterinarian, need for repeat checks, follow-up advice, and possible complications were clearly communicated. A provisional ultrasound findings and treatment plan were provided during the consultation itself, so treatment was not held back due to the detailed report.

Coco was subsequently managed elsewhere and, as we understand, euthanized by the primary veterinarian within a few days. Given the severity and instability of Coco’s condition, close monitoring and timely reassessment were essential and were clearly advised. No follow-up updates were shared with us, and further treatment continued elsewhere, outside our supervision. Therefore, it is unfair and incorrect to hold our clinic responsible for an outcome in a patient who was presented in an advanced condition, seen by us only once, and then managed elsewhere. We understand the grief of losing a pet, but repeated reviews under different names for the same case are misleading and unacceptable.

featured_reviews.review_text:
If you love your pet and do not wish to lose them, please find better veterinary care elsewhere. This hospital is the absolute worst, offering zero personal attention, no empathy, and a complete lack of transparency. My sister admitted her cat here, and the staff showed a heartbreaking lack of responsibility. They completely failed to explain what treatment was being administered and provided no medical details, leaving us entirely in the dark about our pet's condition.

To make matters worse, their handling of the animal was incredibly rough and unprofessional. We saw the cat with multiple blood marks and unmanaged blood clots, showing clear signs of distress and neglect. Tragically, we ended up losing our beloved cat due to their incompetence. This establishment is completely unprofessional, and I strongly recommend that you do not admit your pets here if you want to keep them safe.

featured_reviews.name: Dhawal Hardikar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very Bad Experience – Bapat Clinic, Thane

I am writing this review with deep anger and sadness. I lost my cat because this clinic refused to provide proper emergency care. My cat was struggling to breathe and clearly needed urgent help, but the staff did not take the situation seriously. Because of their negligence and lack of compassion, my pet did not survive.

It is shocking and heartbreaking that people who call themselves doctors can be so heartless toward animals. Veterinarians are supposed to care for and protect animals, but here it felt like there was no concern at all. Doctors who cannot understand the pain and suffering of animals should not be practicing.

The receptionist was also extremely rude and disrespectful. She had no manners and did not know how to speak to worried pet owners. Instead of helping, the staff seemed more interested in money than in saving lives.

I strongly warn other pet owners: please do not bring your pets to this clinic if you truly care about them. Your pet deserves better care, compassion, and professionalism than what this place provides.

featured_reviews.name: Nikita Sarade
featured_reviews.review_text:
Rating: 0/5 Stars
I am absolutely devastated. I gave this clinic two separate chances to help my birds, and both times, I walked away with a dead pet. The first time, I thought it might have been an tragic accident or a misunderstanding of the treatment. But after returning a second time with another bird and experiencing the exact same outcome—losing them almost immediately after bringing them home—it is clear that there is a systemic pattern of incompetence and medical negligence at this facility.
The medications they provide are either incorrect or improperly explained, and their staff clearly does not have the specialized knowledge required to treat birds safely. They discharge animals that are clearly unstable, leading to the trauma of watching your pet pass away the moment you get through your front door.
To lose one bird is a tragedy; to lose two under the care of the same clinic is a warning to every other pet owner. This place is a danger to avian lives. They lack transparency, expertise, and basic professional accountability. Save yourself the heartbreak and take your birds anywhere else.

featured_reviews.name: Mohd Aathif
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing to formally express my disappointment regarding my recent experience with Dr. Bapat Pet Boarding. While I believe the physical care provided to my cat over the last 11 days was satisfactory, the facility failed significantly in fulfilling the service agreements made during the onboarding process.
Specifically, I was assured prior to payment that I would receive daily photo and video updates of my pet to ensure peace of mind. Unfortunately, this commitment was not met. Over the entire 11-day stay, I received updates only once or twice, and even then, only after I proactively called to request them. Despite raising a formal complaint during the stay, the consistency did not improve; I received one update following my complaint, only for the communication to cease immediately afterward.
While pet health is the priority, the emotional well-being of the owner and the integrity of a service agreement are equally important. The lack of transparency and failure to keep a verbal and professional promise regarding communication made this a stressful experience rather than a seamless one.
